subtitle: Standardizing how your users send email from Salesforce

caption: The App Launcher search box finds Email Templates — a user-facing object every org already has.
The Lightning email builder isn't on by default — a permission set grants 'Access drag-and-drop content builder.'
A new template asks for a Related Entity Type (for merge fields), a Folder, and an Enhanced Letterhead to apply.
Save the template, then click Edit in Builder to lay out the email with drag-and-drop components.
